structural_gaps: sample domain monochrome 8-bit; no plane model/bit depth/subsampling/chroma location/color/HDR/alpha
time is an integer interval index; no rational PTS/duration/VFR
one canvas per stream; no epochs/resolution change mid-stream
single state/checkpoint/interval chain; no bidirectional structure or reference management
materialization owns its destination (Canvas); no caller-owned targets; no presentation
representation ladder stops at transform/rANS/RAW; no subpixel/local motion/spatial/cross-plane/grain
no foreign ingest (everything synthetic or raw Gray8)
partial decode still returns owned crops; the caller-owned target refactor is new
decisions: format v2 + video universe v2 for V.1; v1 parser/decoder/goldens permanent (dispatch on header prefix)
two clocks: explicit-interval procedural state machine + declarative rational media timeline; never float
epochs declare full media interpretation; observations tagged; change of any declared property is an epoch boundary
canonical storage planar/tight/LE, u8 <=8-bit, u16 >8-bit, float falls to exact opaque raw-bit planes
independent-plane correctness first (V.1.2), shared motion geometry later, cross-plane prediction an ablation
object identity hashes the canonical layout-aware record; BLAKE3; structural/economic identity, no ML
representation ladder ordered by staging; every new family earns itself in an ablation court
bidirectional prediction NOT in the V.1.1-V.1.10 critical path
DSFB zero-authority reuse; exhaustive oracle; complete byte cost; optimize gate M(D0)==M(D1) and J(D1)<J(D0)
caller-owned materialization targets; materialize_into primitive; historical wrappers allocate+delegate
damage and demand are separate graphs; damage conservative and courted; buffer age exploited safely; headless target first
directness gate: zero full canonical staging + zero full RGB staging during native playback; measured VideoDirectReport
foreign decode import/export only, subprocess ffmpeg/ffprobe, narrow NUT pipe, framehash oracle, canonical hash, atomic import
export default Matroska + FFV1 v3; layout/depth preserving or UNSUPPORTED_EXACT_EXPORT
multi-dimensional exactness flags; source bitstream archival is provenance, never procedural efficiency
